_header: ===== cherrypick-contango -- the VIX/VIX3M regime switch, held in shares (paper-only) =====
_what_this_is: Each arm holds SVXY while VIX/VIX3M says contango and SHV (T-bills) while it does not, deciding once a session ten minutes before the close off the shared stream cache. Arms differ only in the switch's two thresholds. Copy to ~/.cherrypick/config/contango.json (or a git-ignored config.json here).
_source_note: stream_cache_db overrides the shared stream cache path and technicals_db the technicals store (read only for fund distributions); null means the suite default.
defaults_header: ===== the switch, its fills, its window =====
_switch_note: enter_below: hold the risk fund when the ratio is under this. exit_at_or_above: hold the cash fund when the ratio is at or over this. Between the two the arm keeps what it holds. Equal values make a plain one-threshold switch. An inverted pair (exit below entry) is refused at the first tick.
_fill_note: Fills at mid; slippage is a separate cost, the larger of half the quoted spread and slippage_floor_bps of mid, per share. A quote wider than max_spread_bps is waited out to the next tick in the window. Fees: buys free, sells pay the SEC fee and FINRA TAF. Whole shares; the remainder stays as cash earning nothing.
_window_note: The decision window opens decision_minutes_before_close before the regular close (15:50, or 12:50 on an early close) and stays open decision_window_minutes. An arm that cannot act by its end is recorded missed and keeps its holding; nothing fills after the window.
_capital_note: starting_capital opens each arm's paper account the first time the arm is seen. Changing it later does not re-capitalise an existing account: that is a new arm.
_arms_note: control: the plain switch at 0.97, the rule curve gates its entries on. flipexit: in below 0.97, out only at a real inversion (1.0), holding through the band. Replayed on SVXY 2018-03..2026-10 with SHV as cash, see the package CLAUDE.md for the numbers. A leverage arm (SVIX, -1x) is a config block away -- risk_symbol SVIX -- and is deliberately not declared: SVIX replayed worse.
